title: China Price Check: 10 km Taxi Is $27 in NYC, $7 in China | China Travel Expert
description:
A 10 km taxi ride costs about $27 in New York — and about $7 in Shanghai. Same distance, same kind of economy ride, roughly a quarter of the price.

In Shanghai a ~10 km Didi Express (快车) runs around 50 yuan (~$7): a small base fare plus about 2 yuan a kilometre. In New York the same ride stacks a base fare, ~$1.75–2.50 per mile, ~$0.35 per minute, and a TLC congestion surcharge — landing near $27 off-peak, and much more during surge. Both figures are standard ride-hail economy tier, converted to USD (~7.1 yuan to the dollar).

🧭 Expert Tip: You don't need a Chinese bank account — link a Visa/Mastercard inside Alipay or WeChat, then call a Didi right in the app. Fares still spike in rain and rush hour, so check the estimate first.
